card.title: IPhone XS Not Charging

claims.statement: iPhone XS not charging: rule out the earpiece flex (liquid on flood illuminator/ALS), then most cases are fixed by replacing Yangtze U3300 (on the bottom side of the top board); test top board only—about 0.006 A suggests Yangtze. Rarely Hydra.

procedure: Unplug all but screen, port, battery.
Split and test top board; replace Yangtze U3300; then Hydra.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
